profile.headline: Building Intelligent Experiences.
profile.supportingText: AI/ML enthusiast, developer, and builder turning ideas into practical digital products.
profile.bioShort: B.Tech CSE (AI & ML) student focused on architecting intelligent, end-to-end applications that bridge foundational algorithms and clean, responsive software engineering.
bioLong: I am an engineering undergraduate specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. My engineering journey revolves around turning theoretical models into practical, responsive, and reliable software that solves tangible everyday problems.

From multi-order route coordination in OYEE to conversational desktop intelligence in Oye AI Assistant and agentic travel planning in RoamAgent, I explore algorithmic problem solving, modern web applications, and agentic workflows.
